card.line: Bozrah was a fortress city in Edom, home of an early Edomite king. The prophets named it when they spoke of God's judgment on Edom.

moments.title: Jobab the king
moments.text: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king of Edom in his place. This was before any king reigned over Israel.

moments.title: A sacrifice in Bozrah
moments.text: Isaiah says the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom. It is part of His day of vengeance.

moments.title: One coming from Bozrah
moments.text: Isaiah sees someone coming from Edom, from Bozrah, in crimson-stained garments. He says, "It is I, proclaiming vindication, mighty to save."

moments.title: Bozrah to be a ruin
moments.text: The LORD swears by Himself that Bozrah will become a desolation, a disgrace, a ruin, and a curse. He says an eagle will spread its wings over Bozrah, and Edom's mighty men will be afraid.

moments.title: Fire on Bozrah's citadels
moments.text: Because Edom pursued his brother with the sword, the LORD says He will send fire upon Teman to consume the citadels of Bozrah.
